what: Two decisions from integrate (01009, 00976). (1) Delete load-cargo and project-model now; do not wait for blaze-wasm (excluded from the root workspace, so the check loop is unaffected). Tell integrate-vfs the moment they are gone: it deletes vfs + vfs-notify in one step then. (2) Then rewrite crates/blaze-wasm/src/pack/record.rs onto blaze_lower: `record` takes a job's lowered front end (`&blaze_lower::Lowered`) instead of loading a workspace through project_model/load_cargo, and the `pack` command gets it from a `blaze serve` job (add the serve work kind that hands the Lowered to a callback in blaze-cargo/src/serve). Build scripts and proc macros are the daemon's sandboxed runs, never cargo check or the sysroot proc-macro server. Update blaze-wasm's Cargo.toml and its own Cargo.lock (it is its own workspace). Report DELETED lines for integrate.
